question: When were the first modern Olympic Games held in Athens?
fact: About 240 athletes from 14 nations competed in Athens in April 1896. Winners got a silver medal and an olive branch.

question: When was the first Super Bowl played?
fact: The Green Bay Packers beat the Kansas City Chiefs 35–10 on 15 January 1967 in Los Angeles. It wasn't sold out.

question: When did US college players beat the Soviet Union in the 'Miracle on Ice'?
fact: The 4–3 win came at the Lake Placid Winter Olympics in February 1980. The US then beat Finland to take gold.

question: When did Roger Bannister run the first mile under four minutes?
fact: Bannister ran 3:59.4 in Oxford on 6 May 1954. His record lasted just 46 days.

question: When did Diego Maradona score his 'Hand of God' goal against England?
fact: Four minutes later, in the same 1986 World Cup quarter-final in Mexico City, he dribbled past five England players to score again.

question: When did Usain Bolt run his 100 m world record of 9.58 seconds?
fact: Bolt set it at the 2009 World Championships in Berlin, in the same stadium where Jesse Owens won in 1936.

question: When did Finland win its first men's Ice Hockey World Championship?
fact: Finland beat Sweden 4–1 in the 1995 final in Stockholm. Ville Peltonen scored a hat-trick.

question: When were the first Winter Olympics held, in Chamonix?
fact: Chamonix 1924 was first called 'International Winter Sports Week'. It was named the first Winter Olympics afterwards.

question: When did Tiger Woods win his first Masters?
fact: Woods was 21 and won by 12 strokes, still the biggest winning margin in Masters history.

question: When did Leicester City win the Premier League as 5000-to-1 outsiders?
fact: Leicester had nearly been relegated the season before. Bookmakers paid out millions on the 5000–1 odds.

question: When did Nadia Comăneci score the first perfect 10 in Olympic gymnastics?
fact: She was 14, in Montreal. The scoreboard could only show three digits, so it read 1.00.

question: When were the first Wimbledon Championships played?
fact: Only men's singles were played in 1877. Spencer Gore won in front of about 200 spectators.

question: When was the first FIFA World Cup played?
fact: Uruguay hosted and won the first World Cup in 1930, beating Argentina 4–2 in Montevideo.

question: When did Jackie Robinson break Major League Baseball's colour line?
fact: Robinson debuted for the Brooklyn Dodgers on 15 April 1947. Every MLB player now wears his number 42 on that day.

question: When did Muhammad Ali beat George Foreman in the 'Rumble in the Jungle'?
fact: Ali used his 'rope-a-dope' tactic in Kinshasa, Zaire, and knocked Foreman out in the eighth round.

question: When did Michael Phelps win eight gold medals at one Olympics?
fact: Phelps won eight golds in Beijing in 2008, beating Mark Spitz's record of seven from 1972.

question: When did James Naismith invent basketball?
fact: Naismith nailed two peach baskets to a gym balcony in Springfield, Massachusetts, in December 1891.

question: When was the first Tour de France raced?
fact: The 1903 Tour had six stages, some longer than 400 km. Maurice Garin won it.
